items.headline: Turner-Bradshaw's 2 TDs rally Marshall over Middle Tennessee 28-26
items.description: — Xayvion Turner-Bradshaw caught a 69-yard touchdown pass and recovered a teammate’s fumble for the go-ahead touchdown as Marshall rallied past Middle Tennessee 28-26 on Saturday.

items.headline: Marshall meets Middle Tennessee
items.description: Middle Tennessee (1-0) at Marshall (0-1), Sept. 12 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Rocco Becht shines with 4 TDs as No. 18 Penn State beats Marshall 45-0
items.description: — Rocco Becht threw for 271 yards with four touchdowns and No. 18 Penn State beat Marshall 45-0 to begin the Matt Campbell era on Saturday.
